name: mcp-server-facade
title: Expose an MCP tool surface from amc serve for AI-agent evals
description: Umbrella: add a Mezmo-MCP-style streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint (POST /mcp) to amc serve so RCA agents can investigate the generated telemetry (metrics, logs, topology, simulated k8s/Helm state) via MCP tools and be scored against anomalies.csv ground truth, mirroring the mock-mcp-service eval loop. Phased across four subtasks.
creator: sdelmas
notes: All four subtasks shipped (PRs #172/#173/#175/#176). amc serve now exposes a 15-tool MCP endpoint at POST /mcp with mcp-family command tracing and a tested --mcp-eval-mode ground-truth wall. Umbrella design decisions held; no synthetic-node/YAML-export/multi-scenario work needed for v1.
